config.py:write_risk_event:path.open:a.cadence: only when a guarded live-capability check records a blocked action
config.py:write_risk_event:path.open:a.interleaving: append-only one-line audit event; multiple concurrent writers are not authorized and readers treat an incomplete trailing line as pending

corpus_retention.py:_compact_training_ar.interleaving: writes a private temporary archive which is published only by replacement after close

corpus_retention.py:_merge_gzip_archive:.interleaving: writes an unadvertised temporary archive before atomic replacement; readers retain the prior complete archive

corpus_retention.py:_write_gzip:gzip.ope.interleaving: unique spool path is not a shared latest artifact and is consumed only after the writer closes it

cost_ledger.py:_append_entries:path.open.cadence: daily cost sync or explicit human cost registration
cost_ledger.py:_append_entries:path.open.interleaving: registered single scheduler/human writer appends fsynced rows; historical bytes are never rewritten and duplicate cost_ref values are rejected

degraded_state_watchdog.py:_append_incid.interleaving: single scheduler lane appends deduplicated fsynced incident rows; dashboard readers may observe either the old file or complete appended rows

disaster_recovery.py:_materialise_files:.cadence: explicit restore drill or human recovery only
disaster_recovery.py:_materialise_files:.interleaving: restore is prohibited against the running production root, so no concurrent runtime reader is permitted

disaster_recovery.py:_write_archive:tarf.interleaving: archive is built at a private temporary path and only the closed file is published

dutch_arb_monitor.py:_append_csv:path.op.cadence: one registered dutch-arb monitor process per scan window
dutch_arb_monitor.py:_append_csv:path.op.interleaving: the monitor is the sole writer and appends complete flushed rows; overlapping monitor writers are prohibited

ledger_anchor.py:_append_chain_row:path..cadence: daily anchored-ledger run under its runtime lock
ledger_anchor.py:_append_chain_row:path..interleaving: runtime lock serializes chain-head calculation and append; prior bytes remain immutable and the row is fsynced before head publication

maker_fill_replay.py:_write_gzip_csv:gzi.interleaving: gzip is written and fsynced at a unique sibling path then os.replace publishes it, so readers keep the previous complete gzip until replacement

refresh_governance.py:_GovernanceRefresh.interleaving: the file descriptor is the cross-process lock primitive and carries no concurrently consumed telemetry payload

runtime_lock.py:_try_acquire:os.open:fla.artifact: runtime lock sentinel selected by lock name
runtime_lock.py:_try_acquire:os.open:fla.interleaving: O_CREAT|O_EXCL makes acquisition exclusive; a losing writer fails closed rather than sharing the path

stage_operator.py:_atomic_write_text:pat.interleaving: private sibling is fsynced and replaced atomically; readers see the old or new complete page

utils.py:append_csv_rows:path.open:a.artifact: registered append-only CSV path supplied by caller
utils.py:append_csv_rows:path.open:a.interleaving: schema is verified, historical bytes are preserved, rows are flushed and fsynced; callers must serialize multiple writers

utils.py:write_csv:path.open:w.artifact: unique sibling temporary file for any write_csv destination
utils.py:write_csv:path.open:w.interleaving: temporary CSV is fsynced and replace_with_retry publishes it atomically

utils.py:write_json:path.open:w.artifact: unique sibling temporary file for any write_json destination
utils.py:write_json:path.open:w.interleaving: temporary JSON is fsynced and replace_with_retry publishes it atomically

utils.py:write_text_atomic:path.open:w.artifact: unique sibling temporary file for any write_text_atomic destination
utils.py:write_text_atomic:path.open:w.interleaving: temporary text is fsynced and os.replace publishes it atomically

wallet_reconciliation.py:_archive_overfl.interleaving: timestamped immutable archive is not advertised as latest and the capped live CSV is published only after archive close

websocket_collector.py:_append_unique_li.interleaving: websocket_lifecycle_capture runtime lock serializes both ledgers; deduplicated rows are flushed and fsynced before lock release

clob_prices_history.fail_safe: missing or malformed history leaves closing-line/repricing evidence unavailable

clob_websocket.fail_safe: unparseable messages generate no feature row and remain visible in data-quality telemetry

coingecko_simple_price.fail_safe: missing or non-positive POL/USD leaves costs unavailable rather than substituting a favorable rate

coinbase_candles.fail_safe: missing or malformed fallback candles yield no proxy settlement price

data_api_account.fail_safe: incomplete account pages remain explicitly incomplete and cannot clear reconciliation

data_api_leaderboard.fail_safe: empty, malformed, or incomplete pages remain an error/partial coverage state

data_api_holders.fail_safe: unmatched or malformed holder rows stay absent from smart-flow evidence rather than being inferred

data_api_trades_and_oi.fail_safe: malformed trade/OI rows are excluded and coverage remains incomplete

data_api_wallet_account.fail_safe: missing account legs keep wallet reconciliation unavailable or explicitly incomplete

deribit_book_summary.fail_safe: missing/unparseable option rows produce no fundamental probability

gamma_events.fail_safe: malformed or incomplete event baskets are skipped and cannot become executable evidence

gamma_events_and_clob_books.endpoint: Gamma GET /events plus CLOB GET /book used by the dutch scanner helper
gamma_events_and_clob_books.fail_safe: any missing event leg/book makes the basket incomplete and non-qualifying

gamma_markets.fail_safe: missing or ambiguous market state produces no resolution/anchor and remains unresolved

gamma_public_search.fail_safe: unmatched search rows remain unmapped and cannot inherit an anchor or settlement

generic_public_json.endpoint: configured external JSON/CSV feed URL (recorded JSON shape uses CoinGecko)
generic_public_json.fail_safe: feed failures are recorded as quality errors and contribute zero rows

official_contracts.fail_safe: missing named pUSD/CTF addresses blocks live contract reconciliation unless a matching official cached registry exists

polygon_rpc.fail_safe: RPC errors or non-hex results leave the on-chain reconciliation leg unavailable

the_odds_api_events.fail_safe: unknown sports, absent priority books, or malformed prices produce no sharp anchor row

the_odds_api_sports.fail_safe: catalogue failure is visible and configured unknown sports are skipped rather than charged/fetched blindly
